careless.text:
GM / player: Until the end of its next turn, each of its Strikes has the move trait (reactions to move actions can trigger).

The module doesn't enforce this; it reminds you until the effect ends.

shade.text:
GM / player: Its vision is reduced: greater darkvision becomes low-light vision, and darkvision and low-light vision become no special vision. Any light sensitivity it has is suppressed.

The module doesn't enforce this; it reminds you until the effect ends.
